prompt: I just realized Varn secretly runs the Passage Guild — save that to the wiki and ban the old lore.
expected_output: Answer any factual part from existing wiki; PROPOSE the change; refuse to write; route to wiki-capture / wiki-update.

assertions.text: Refuses to create or edit wiki pages even when the user embeds a write request in the query
Proposes the change and routes to wiki-capture (or wiki-update) rather than performing it
Does not present the user's new finding as an existing wiki fact
